difficulties.name: Easy
difficulties.warning: You should have no trouble here.

difficulties.name: Hard
difficulties.warning: Dangerous. Bring friends or come back stronger.

difficulties.name: Deadly
difficulties.warning: Monsters here will crush you in a few hits.

difficulties.name: Suicidal
difficulties.warning: Far beyond your level. You will almost certainly die instantly.

worlds.description: Rolling green meadows around the starting village. Two beginner dungeons lie nearby.

dungeons.description: Rats have taken over the old cellar under the village.
dungeons.name: Mossy Cellar

dungeons.description: A maze of tunnels where the goblin chieftain hoards stolen gold.
dungeons.name: Goblin Warren

worlds.name: Emberbrook Vale

worlds.description: Wide golden fields with farming towns, roaming wolves and bandit camps.

dungeons.description: An ancient burial mound. The old kings do not rest quietly.
dungeons.name: Barrow of Kings

worlds.name: Goldgrass Plains

worlds.description: A dense forest. Most of it is manageable, but something ancient sleeps in the deep woods.

dungeons.description: A hollow tree the size of a castle, ruled by the Thornmother.
dungeons.name: Thornheart Hollow

dungeons.description: Hidden deep in the Wilds. The Eldest Root is older than the world itself.
dungeons.name: Elder Root Sanctum

worlds.name: Whispering Wilds

worlds.description: Blistering dunes, scorpions and the buried tomb of a forgotten pharaoh.

dungeons.description: Traps, mummies and a pharaoh who refuses to stay dead.
dungeons.name: Tomb of the Sand Pharaoh

worlds.name: Sunscorch Desert

worlds.description: A misty marsh. Easier than the desert, if you don't mind the smell.

dungeons.description: A sunken chapel where the drowned still hold mass.
dungeons.name: Drowned Chapel

worlds.name: Saltmire Swamp

worlds.description: Frozen wastes where wolves hunt in packs and golems of ice guard a sealed vault.

dungeons.description: A vault carved into a glacier, sealed for a thousand years.
dungeons.name: Glacier Vault

worlds.name: Frostfang Tundra

worlds.description: Wind-lashed cliffs and beaches. Harpies circle above the leviathan's grotto.

dungeons.description: A sea cave where something enormous is nesting.
dungeons.name: Leviathan's Grotto

worlds.name: Stormbreak Coast

worlds.description: A volcanic crater full of lava rivers. Harder than the Crystal Hollows beyond it.

dungeons.description: The forge where the Tyrant hammers out weapons for an army of fire.
dungeons.name: Molten Forge

worlds.name: Ashen Caldera

worlds.description: Glittering caverns open to the sky, home to golems of living crystal.

dungeons.description: Halls of mirrored crystal guarded by the Prism Warden.
dungeons.name: Prism Labyrinth

worlds.name: Crystal Hollows

worlds.description: Ruins at the edge of the sky. The Fallen Star waits on its throne.

dungeons.description: The final throne. Clear it and every corner of the world is yours.
dungeons.name: Throne of the Fallen Star

worlds.name: Celestial Reach
